name: Stone altar
description: A village temple's altar of pale dressed grey stone on a slightly wider plinth step, with a carved band under its overhanging top slab, a dull red altar cloth over the top hanging down the front, and three short ivory candles in iron dishes. It stands behind its origin, so it can go against a wall.
